snippet.title: CRASHOUT CREW | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the world’s “most efficient” warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfil orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern… just try not to crash out!

WISHLIST CRASHOUT CREW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583210/Crashout_Crew/ 

You'll be able to yoink up the demo as part of Steam Next Fest starting October 13th until October 20th! Give us your feedback, or don't. Ok no really, we want feedback before we launch the full version.

SOOOO Crashout Crew is the other half to the 2025 game-jam projects we made this year. After the recent cancellation of Going Under 2, we decided to explore the goofy and chaotic multiplayer side of making games. While SOME of Aggro Crab developed PEAK with Landfall, the rest of the studio has been locked in this year to produce Crashout Crew! 

That means we're now publicly working on TWO GAMES! So yeah, PEAK is still being worked on internally but now it's time to glaze CRASHOUT CREW. 

Crashout Crew should be delivered safely to you in 2026 on Steam! 

───────────────────────────────────────────────────
